jobs.title: VP, Strategy and Operations
jobs.description:
**Job Description Summary**
===========================


The VP, Strategy and Operations acts as the Chief Procurement Officer's principal partner in developing and executing strategy and driving the transformation agenda: responsible for developing category strategies to optimise value from third\-party spend, building the procurement operating model, and architecting the procurement modernization agenda, focused on technology, AI and process optimisation across source\-to\-pay. The role demands a strategic, analytical and operational mindset in equal measure, deep functional expertise, a data and technology driven approach, and the ability to lead through influence rather than direct line management.


The role would suit an experienced and/or qualified procurement professional, operating at senior level and requiring deep and broad expertise across procurement strategy, technology and operations. Works independently, sets direction for others and mentors junior members of the team. The role carries no direct category accountability of its own, but rather partners with category and business leaders, and is measured through the results of these teams.

  

  

**About the Team**
==================


RELX leverages its spend through a central Global Procurement function responsible for delivering procurement savings, driving supply chain efficiencies, and mitigating supply risk across all major spend categories — technology, cloud and AI, data and content, marketing, professional services, contingent labour, print and production, facilities and travel. Global Procurement is led by the Chief Procurement Officer, supported by Global Category Leaders and a Programme Management Office responsible for procurement policy, process, tools and operational activity across all spend categories.

  

  

**About the Role**
==================


We are looking for an analytically and intellectually driven senior leader, team player and self\-starter with deep operational and strategy expertise across the procurement domain. The role would suit an individual from a technology, finance, consulting or information services background. This role provides significant exposure to and opportunities to influence senior executives across multiple business segments.

  

The role will be based at a primary RELX location in North America, with periodic international travel to our global offices, and reports to the RELX Chief Procurement Officer.

  

  

**Main Accountabilities**
=========================


* Own the development and refresh of the Global Procurement multi\-year strategy, aligned to RELX Group strategy and to each business area's plan.


* Translate strategy into a sequenced transformation roadmap with clear owners, milestones and benefit cases; run the governance that keeps it on track.


* Own end\-to\-end source\-to\-contract process design and performance, and the technology roadmap.


* Drive process simplification, automation and self\-service so that policy\-compliant buying is the path of least resistance for the business.


* Design and evolve the procurement operating model — organisation shape, category architecture, centre\-led versus embedded resourcing, location strategy and the interfaces with other business areas.


* Partner closely with the PMO to ensure improvement initiatives are executed in alignment with strategy.


* Lead and oversee strategic initiatives that cut across categories: supplier consolidation programmes, third\-party cost transformation, procurement integration in M\&A, and make\-versus\-buy reviews.


* Oversee data management and data quality.


* Coach and develop a geographically distributed team of specialists and people managers.


* Build senior relationships across business areas and corporate functions.

  

  

**Requirements**
================


* Have substantial senior experience in procurement, sourcing or third\-party cost management within a large, complex, multinational organisation, including time in a strategy, operations or transformation role.


* Have category expertise across technology and indirect procurement.


* Have a proven track record of designing and delivering procurement or functional transformation at scale — operating model change, technology deployment, or process re\-engineering.


* Have deep working knowledge of the source\-to\-pay lifecycle and at least one major S2P platform, including implementation or major upgrade experience.


* Be strong in commercial and financial fluency — able to build a business case, define and defend savings methodology, and hold a credible conversation with a CFO or divisional finance director.


* Be able to influence and earn credibility with executive stakeholders in a federated, multi\-business\-unit environment where authority is earned rather than granted.


* Have experience leading distributed teams, including managing managers, and building capability.


* Be an exceptional analytical thinker, comfortable with spend data, taxonomies and analytics tooling.


* Be a confident communicator, able to create clear, decision\-oriented materials for senior leadership, including Board\-level presentations.

  

This job is eligible for an annual incentive bonus.This posting is for an existing vacancy.

We are committed to providing a fair and accessible hiring process. If you have a disability or other need that requires accommodation or adjustment, please let us know by completing our Applicant Request Support Form or please contact 1\-855\-833\-5120\.

jobs.title: Associate Director, Operational Risk & Enterprise Crisis Management
jobs.description:
**Why you’ll love working here:**

* high\-performance, people\-focused culture
* our commitment that equity, diversity, and inclusion are fundamental to our work environment and business success, which helps employees feel valued and empowered to be their authentic selves
* learning and development initiatives, including workshops, Speaker Series events and access to LinkedIn Learning, that support employees’ career growth
* membership in HOOPP’s world class defined benefit pension plan, which can serve as an important part of your retirement security
* competitive, 100% company\-paid extended health and dental benefits for permanent employees, including coverage supporting our team's diversity and mental health (e.g., gender affirmation, fertility and drug treatment, psychological support benefits of $2,500 per year, parental leave top\-up, and a health spending account).
* optional post\-retirement health and dental benefits subsidized at 50%
* yoga classes, meditation workshops, nutritional consultations, and wellness seminars
* the opportunity to make a difference and help take care of those who care for us, by providing a financially secure retirement for Ontario healthcare workers

**Job Summary**

  

This fast\-paced role is ideal for someone who thrives on identifying and remediating operational risk challenges with a focus on the investment environment. Reporting to the Senior Director, the Associate Director will help evolve HOOPP's Operational Risk Management (ORM) and Enterprise Crisis and Continuity (ECC) programs by promoting a strong risk culture and partnering with business areas across the organization to identify and mitigate key operational risks.  



  

The role will support both programs. For Operational Risk, the Associate Director will support the execution and enhancement of HOOPP's ORM programs including vendor risk management, operational risk event reporting, key risk indicators and industry event surveillance. This role will also work directly with front office trading teams to review end\-to\-end processes and surface risks, inefficiencies and control gaps. For ECC, this role will lead the execution and ongoing management of HOOPP's Enterprise Crisis Management and Business Continuity programs, including plan development and testing and response management during actual disruptions.  



  

We are looking for someone who brings an exceptional command of AI and applies it through a strategic lens—identifying high\-value opportunities, translating emerging capabilities into practical business solutions, and guiding responsible AI adoption to improve decision\-making, efficiency, innovation, and long\-term organizational value.  



  

**What you will do:**

  

For designated divisions, support the Operational Risk Management (ORM) and Enterprise Crisis and Continuity programs.  



  

Operational Risk:


* Investment Management:
	+ Partner with front office trading teams to review end\-to\-end processes, identify operational risks, inefficiencies, control gaps and opportunities for improvement.
	+ Develop a strong understanding of trading activities, products and workflows to ensure recommendations reflect business needs and market realities.
* Leverage existing risk management processes and capabilities, as well as industry knowledge to support the implementation, enhancement, ongoing maintenance, and execution of HOOPP’s ORM program and underlying processes, including but not limited to:
	+ Vendor Risk Management
	+ Operational Risk Event reporting
	+ Key Risk Indicators
	+ Industry Event surveillance and reporting
* Provide analytical and operational support to the maintenance and execution of HOOPP’s operational risk event reporting process, and the undertaking of associated procedures, including ongoing monitoring of the program for continued relevance and effectiveness.
* Support business partners in their implementation of ORM program components within their respective divisions and provide appropriate oversight to govern the effectiveness of the implementation.
* Support the ongoing development and evolution of an Operational Risk Dashboard that will showcase the results of the key operational risk metrics.
Support on\-demand advisory requests and opportunities, which can include special projects, deep dive analysis and investigations.  
* 

  

Enterprise Crisis and Continuity:


* Oversee the development, enhancement, maintenance, and testing of business continuity plans.
* Facilitate business impact analyses (BIAs), dependency mapping, and risk assessments in collaboration with divisions and IT partners.
* Support enterprise response, recovery, and restoration activities during actual crisis or disruption events.
* Contribute to the ongoing evolution of the Crisis Management program and support the implementation and awareness for leaders, plan owners, and staff.
Provide advisory support to business units on crisis preparedness, continuity planning, and resilience best practices.  
* 

  

Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Information Technology:


* Identify opportunities to use technology, automation and AI to improve efficiency, decision\-making and control effectiveness.
* Support the design, testing and implementation of tools that reduce manual activity, improve data quality and enhance the user experience.
Develop and leverage AI to automate manual processes, which can include ongoing monitoring activities, data extraction and report generation.  
* 

  

**What you bring:**

  

* University education with a degree in business, risk management, or other relevant major.
* 8\+ years of progressive risk management experience, in asset management, pension or financial services industries. Previous pension fund experience is an asset.
* Strong knowledge of the front office trading function and downstream the end\-to\-end processes.

jobs.title: Director, Retirement Strategy
jobs.description:
Global Wealth \& Asset Management is a key growth segment for Manulife, operating across Retail, Wealth, Retirement and Institutional channels in North America, Asia and Europe. The Director, Retirement Strategy will help shape the growth and transformation agenda for the U.S. and Canada Retirement businesses, translating strategic objectives into actionable priorities and quality execution. By strengthening connectivity between Retirement, Wealth and broader Manulife capabilities, this role will support our mission to make decisions easier and lives better for our customers. This high\-profile opportunity provides broad exposure to senior leaders, complex strategic priorities and enterprise\-wide initiatives, while enabling the successful candidate to build deep expertise and influence the future of GWAM.  



  

**Position Responsibilities**
-----------------------------

* Shape and advance the strategic agenda for the U.S. and Canada Retirement businesses by identifying growth opportunities, strategic risks and value\-creation initiatives.
* Develop strategies that strengthen the Retirement businesses and deepen connectivity with Wealth and broader Manulife capabilities.
* Translate strategic objectives into clear priorities, align discretionary spending with those priorities and support business readiness for execution.
* Partner across GWAM, Finance, Transformation and Business Operations to drive cross\-functional collaboration, monitor delivery and recommend interventions or pivots where required.
* Apply competitive and market intelligence to ensure strategic goals are aspirational, achievable and responsive to industry dynamics.
* Develop clear, decision\-oriented materials for the Board of Directors, Executive Leadership Team, Transformation Delivery Team and other senior audiences.
Lead strategic projects and support other GWAM priorities as business needs evolve.  
* 

  

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* 8–10 years of relevant, progressively senior experience in strategy, transformation, financial services or a related field.
* Strong business, strategic, critical and analytical thinking, with the ability to translate complex issues into practical solutions.
* Demonstrated ability to lead through influence and drive collaboration, accountability and innovation in a matrixed organization.
* Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, exercise sound judgment and deliver results in a dynamic environment.
Superior written and verbal communication skills, including experience preparing materials for senior executive audiences.  
* 

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience in wealth and asset management, retirement or broader financial services.
* Experience developing and executing growth, transformation or enterprise strategies.
* Understanding of the U.S. and Canadian retirement markets, competitive dynamics and industry trends.
* Experience partnering with Finance, Transformation and Business Operations teams to monitor execution and outcomes.
Experience developing Board, Executive Leadership Team or other senior management presentations.  
* 

  

**When You Join Our Team**
--------------------------

* We’ll empower you to learn and grow the career you want.
* We’ll recognize and support you in a flexible environment where well\-being and inclusion are more than just words.
As part of our global team, we’ll support you in shaping the future you want to see.  
*

jobs.title: Transformation Consulting Managing Director
jobs.description:
**Req ID:** 393227
  
  

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward\-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  

We are currently seeking a Transformation Consulting Managing Director to join our team in Toronto, Ontario (CA\-ON), Canada (CA).
  
  

The Sr Infrastructure Transformation and Consulting Director will be responsible for designing, guiding, and overseeing NTT DATA North America’s overall technology infrastructure with a primary focus on Infrastructure Transformation. This role will align IT strategy with business goals by assessing current\-state environments, identifying modernization opportunities, and creating a blueprint for future technology development, including standards, policies, and architecture frameworks to support efficient, secure, scalable, and transformation\-ready operations across the enterprise; essentially acting as a bridge between business needs and technical implementation.
  
  

* This position is remote, however will require some travel to the client site.


**Key responsibilities:**  

**IT Strategic planning:**  

Develop and maintain the enterprise architecture roadmap, aligning IT strategy with business objectives for NTT DATA, Merger and Acquisition integrations, and enterprise\-wide Infrastructure Transformation initiatives.
  
  

**Architecture design:**  

Design and document the overall system architecture, including application, data, infrastructure, cloud, security, and transformation components to support modernization and scalable enterprise operations.
  
  

**Technology evaluation:**  

Research and evaluate new technologies, platforms, and infrastructure modernization approaches to identify opportunities for transformation, operational improvement, and long\-term scalability.
  
  

**Standards and governance:**  

Establish and enforce architectural standards, guidelines, and governance processes to ensure consistency and compliance
  
  

**Collaboration:**  

Work with various stakeholders including business leaders, global EAs, project teams, and technical teams to understand requirements and translate them into architectural solutions.
  
  

**Cost optimization:**  

Analyze and optimize IT spending by identifying potential cost savings through architectural improvements.
  
  

**Risk management:**  

Identify and mitigate potential risks associated with technology architecture.
  
  

**Communication and documentation:**  

Clearly communicate architectural concepts and decisions to technical and non\-technical audiences through documentation and presentations.
  
  

Basic Requirements
  
  

* 11\+ years of experience in enterprise architecture, infrastructure transformation, cloud computing, Generative AI, LLMs, databases, networking, security, and application development, with a deep understanding of how these technologies support business and modernization objectives.


Additional Preferences
  
  

**Leadership skills:**  

Minimum of 11\+ years of experience influencing and guiding cross\-functional teams toward implementing an enterprise architecture vision, with demonstrated ability to lead infrastructure transformation and modernization efforts.
  
  

**Business acumen:**  

Ability to understand business needs and translate them into technical requirements.
  
  

**Communication skills:**  

Excellent written and verbal communication skills to effectively collaborate with diverse stakeholders.
  
  

**Analytical skills:**  

Ability to analyze complex systems, identify potential issues, and propose solutions.
  
  

NTT DATA provides a reasonable range of compensation for Canada\-based positions. The starting pay range for this role is $187,192 \- $311,988 CAD. Actual compensation will depend on a number of factors, including the candidate’s relevant experience, technical skills, and other qualifications. This position may also be eligible for incentive compensation based on individual and/or company performance. If the position offered is temporary, the position will not be eligible for incentive compensation.
  
  

This position is eligible for the Company’s comprehensive benefits program in Canada, including customizable health and dental coverage with telemedicine, wellness credits, and gym discounts. Employees receive income protection through life, disability, and optional insurance plans, plus access to a 24/7 Employee Assistance Program. Additional perks include retirement savings, a remote work allowance for eligible employees, and various discounts and travel insurance.
  
  

About NTT DATA
  
  

NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100\. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise\-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start\-up partners. NTT DATA is a part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in RD.
  
  

Whenever possible, we hire locally to NTT DATA offices or client sites. This ensures we can provide timely and effective support tailored to each client’s needs. While many positions offer remote or hybrid work options, these arrangements are subject to change based on client requirements. For employees near an NTT DATA office or client site, in\-office attendance may be required for meetings or events, depending on business needs. At NTT DATA, we are committed to staying flexible

jobs.title: Director, PathWise Actuarial Implementation and AI-Enabled Process Transformation
jobs.description:
Posting Description:
**Director, PathWise Actuarial Implementation and AI\-Enabled Process Transformation**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


The Life Solutions division at Aon is seeking a Director to lead large\-scale PathWise implementation projects. This role also supports AI\-enabled process transformation initiatives for life and annuity insurers across North America. This client\-facing role combines actuarial expertise, implementation leadership, and technology\-enabled transformation to help insurers modernize modelling, reporting, workflow automation, AI\-enabled systems, and operational workflows.  

The Director will work within Aon Life Solutions, part of Aon’s Reinsurance Strategy and Technology Group to translate business needs into practical implementation plans, scalable operating models, and measurable delivery outcomes. This role will be based in Canada. **Applicants must be legally authorized to work in Canada. This role is not eligible for sponsorship, and we are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa or work permit.****Aon is in the business of better decisions**
----------------------------------------------


At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.
As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.**What the day will look like**
-------------------------------

**Implementation and Client Delivery*** Lead and support large\-scale PathWise implementation projects for life and annuity insurers across North America.
* Handle key implementation workstreams, including model migration, data integration, testing, reconciliation, workflow design, documentation, training, and production deployment.
* Translate client business objectives and current\-state processes into clear delivery plans, target\-state solutions, and implementation roadmaps.
* Develop and migrate actuarial models and production processes for valuation, pricing, financial reporting, capital, ALM, and risk management use cases.
* Support delivery governance, issue resolution, risk management, collaborator communication, post\-implementation stabilization, and client knowledge transfer.

**AI\-Enabled Process Transformation and Innovation**
-----------------------------------------------------

* Identify, prioritize, and continuously refine opportunities to use automation and AI\-enabled capabilities to improve actuarial modelling, reporting, reconciliation, documentation, and analysis processes across the PathWise lifecycle.
* Collaborate closely with the PathWise AI and development teams to translate business difficulties into clear AI use cases, feature requests, and improvements.
* Help clients redesign legacy actuarial workflows into more efficient, scalable, governed, and technology\-enabled operating models.
* Contribute to reusable implementation assets, process transformation playbooks, documentation templates, workflow designs, and AI\-enabled delivery accelerators.
* Lead or support pilots of new PathWise AI features, capturing user feedback and performance metrics, and consolidating insights into actionable recommendations for the PathWise AI roadmap
* Promote responsible and controlled use of AI\-enabled capabilities, including review, validation, traceability, documentation, and governance, and contribute to standard guidance on AI\-enabled workflows

**Business Development and Market Support**
-------------------------------------------

* Support PathWise growth in the North American life and annuity market through client solutioning, demonstrations (including AI\-enabled capabilities), proposals, implementation estimates, and project planning.
* Partner with senior leaders in client discussions on actuarial modernization, implementation strategy, process automation, AI\-enabled transformation, and business value.
* Develop proof\-of\-concept materials and presentations on PathWise capabilities, implementation guidelines, and emerging insurance industry issues.
* Develop and share case studies, training materials, and thought leadership that showcase successful AI\-enabled PathWise use cases and evolving capabilities

**How this opportunity is different**
-------------------------------------


PathWise is Aon’s high\-performance actuarial software platform, enabling insurers to model liabilities, assets, capital, and related business processes with speed, transparency, flexibility, and control. The platform supports modern actuarial modelling, scenario analysis, financial reporting, ALM, risk management, and enterprise\-scale production processes.
In this role, you will help clients migrate models and processes into PathWise, improve actuarial production workflows, and apply automation and AI\-enabled capabilities across requirements, model development, testing, reconciliation, documentation, workflow monitoring, and reporting. You will also help identify new AI applications within PathWise, develop improvements with the PathWise AI team, and promote adoption of emerging capabilities across client and internal teams.**Skills and experience that will lead to success**
---------------------------------------------------

* 10\+ years of experience in life insurance, life reinsurance, actuarial consulting, financial technology, actuarial modelling, or enterprise platform implementation.
* Experience with valuation, pricing, ALM, hedging, capital, financial reporting, risk management, model governance, or related actuarial functions.
* Experience supporting or leading implementation, modernization, migration, or transformation projects within actuarial, finance, risk, or insurance technology environments.
* Solid understanding of life and annuity products, reserves, capital, financial reporting, ALM, and risk management.
* Practical experience with actuarial mode

jobs.title: Associate Director, Financial Operations
jobs.description:
**Associate Director, Financial Operations**

**Finance Department**

**Hybrid**

**Full Time, Permanent**

**Level 11**

**Requisition Number:** FIN\-2026\-004


Covenant House helps youth ignite their potential and reclaim their lives. As Canada’s largest agency serving youth who are homeless, trafficked or at risk, we offer the widest range of services to hundreds of young people every day.


More than a place to stay, we provide life\-changing care with unconditional love and respect. We meet youth’s immediate needs and then we work together to achieve their future goals. We offer 24/7 crisis shelter transitional housing options on\-site and, in the community, health and well\-being support, training and skill development, and ongoing care once youth move into the community.


For over 40 years, Covenant House has been dedicated to its mission of serving youth on the street and to protect and safeguard all youth with absolute respect and unconditional love. Since 1982, Covenant House has supported more than 100,000 young people.

 **Overview:**

  

Reporting to the Chief Financial Officer, the Associate Director, Financial Operations provides operational leadership for Covenant House Toronto’s accounting, payroll, financial reporting, audit, charitable regulatory reporting, internal controls, procurement and financial operations. The role is accountable for accurate, timely and reliable financial information and for sustaining a strong, practical control environment.


This is a hands\-on leadership role for a technically strong accountant who can preserve operational continuity while modernizing financial operations. The Associate Director will lead full\-cycle accounting and procurement, complex payroll oversight, audit readiness and regulatory filings, including the annual CRA T3010 Registered Charity Information Return. The role will also advance the effective use of NetSuite, Power BI and related systems, drawing on Sage experience where relevant to legacy processes and transition requirements.


As Covenant House Toronto transforms its finance function, the Associate Director will develop people, document institutional knowledge, standardize processes and embed scalable controls. Over time, the role will extend a collaborative, risk\-based operational assurance approach across the agency, introducing leading practices without creating unnecessary administrative burden or compromising service to internal partners or youth.

**We are currently recruiting for 1 Full\-time Permanent Associate Director, Finance Operations. This is a replacement position within the organization.**

**Responsibilities:**

**1\. Financial Operations and Full\-Cycle Accounting**

* Lead all aspects of monthly, quarterly and annual close processes, including journal entries, reconciliations, accruals, deferrals, allocations and supporting working papers.
* Ensure the integrity of the general ledger, chart of accounts, financial dimensions and underlying financial data.
* Oversee procurement, accounts payable, accounts receivable, cash and banking transactions, fixed assets, restricted and designated funds, and financial recordkeeping.
* Ensure accurate accounting across programs, departments, projects, funding sources and legal or reporting entities, as applicable.
* Prepare and review timely financial statements, schedules and management reports in accordance with applicable accounting standards and organizational policies.
* Maintain clear procedures, accountabilities and service standards for core finance operations.

**2\. Internal Controls, Risk and Operational Assurance**

* Own and continuously strengthen the financial internal control framework, including controls over close, journal entries, reconciliations, payments, revenue, payroll, procurement, cash, banking, system access and segregation of duties.
* Develop a risk\-based program of internal control reviews and operational assurance, beginning with Finance processes and expanding to priority agency processes over time.
* Assess process design and control effectiveness, identify gaps or duplication, document findings and agree practical corrective actions with process owners.
* Partner with operational leaders to introduce scalable leading practices that improve stewardship, consistency and accountability without disrupting business service or creating unnecessary bureaucracy.
* Apply a service\-oriented approach to controls by considering risk, cost, effort and operational impact when recommending changes.
* Monitor remediation plans and recurring control issues, escalating significant risks appropriately.
* Support enterprise risk management, fraud prevention, policy compliance and protection of organizational assets.

**3\. External Audit and Technical Accounting**

* Lead annual external audit planning and execution, including preparation of audit schedules, working papers, financial statement support and coordination of responses.
* Maintain year\-round audit readiness and high\-quality documentation so that audit requirements are addressed efficiently and accurately.

jobs.title: Director I, Finance
jobs.description:
The **Director, Finance** provides leadership and oversight of key accounting, financial reporting, and controllership activities for Dollar Tree's Canadian operations, ensuring the accuracy and integrity of financial results.


This leader will oversee critical components of the monthly, quarterly, and annual close processes, strengthen financial controls, and ensure compliance with U.S. GAAP, Canadian statutory requirements, company policies, and SOX requirements.  



  

The Director will also partner closely with Finance and business leaders in Canada and the U.S. to support budgeting and forecasting, improve financial processes, and provide insights that enable sound business decisions.  



  

This is a highly visible leadership role requiring strong technical accounting expertise, financial acumen, cross\-functional partnership, and the ability to develop high\-performing teams in a complex, fast\-paced organization.  



  

**What You'll Do**
------------------

### **Financial Accounting \& Controllership**

* Provide leadership and oversight for accounting and controllership activities, ensuring the accuracy, completeness, and integrity of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial results.
* Lead key components of the monthly, quarterly, and annual financial close processes, ensuring timely and accurate reporting in accordance with U.S. GAAP and company policies.
* Partner closely with cross\-functional teams in Canada and Finance and Accounting teams in the U.S. to ensure alignment and consistency in financial reporting and accounting practices.
* Ensure compliance with applicable Canadian statutory requirements related to tax, accounting, and financial reporting.
* Review financial results, account reconciliations, journal entries, and supporting schedules to identify trends, variances, risks, and potential accounting issues.
* Ensure accounting transactions are properly recorded, classified, documented, and supported in accordance with established policies and accounting standards.
* Provide technical accounting guidance and determine appropriate accounting treatment for complex or non\-routine transactions.
* Maintain a strong internal control environment and ensure financial processes and documentation support compliance with SOX requirements.
* Partner with internal and external auditors, providing appropriate documentation and ensuring timely resolution of audit requests and findings.

### **Financial Reporting \& Analysis**

* Oversee the preparation and review of financial statements, management reporting, and supporting financial schedules.
* Analyze financial performance and significant account fluctuations, providing senior leadership with clear explanations of results, trends, risks, and opportunities.
* Partner with FP\&A and business leaders to ensure alignment between accounting results, forecasts, budgets, and overall business performance.
* Support the preparation of annual budgets and updates to monthly financial forecasts.
* Develop reporting and financial insights that improve visibility into business performance and support informed decision\-making.
* Identify potential financial risks and proactively partner with leaders to develop appropriate solutions and corrective actions.

### **Process Improvement \& Financial Controls**

* Lead continuous improvement and automation initiatives that simplify financial processes, reduce manual activities, increase efficiency, and strengthen the overall control environment.
* Establish and maintain accounting policies, procedures, controls, and documentation to promote consistency and compliance across the organization.
* Partner with Finance, IT, and other cross\-functional teams on system implementations, enhancements, integrations, and broader transformation initiatives.
* Ensure effective financial controls are incorporated into new processes, systems, and business initiatives.
* Identify opportunities to improve the scalability, accuracy, and efficiency of accounting and financial reporting processes.

### **Leadership \& Business Partnership**

* Lead, coach, and develop a high\-performing Finance team, establishing clear expectations and creating opportunities for continued professional growth.
* Serve as a trusted financial advisor to senior leaders and cross\-functional partners, providing guidance on accounting, financial controls, and business decisions.
* Build strong partnerships across Accounting, FP\&A, Treasury, Tax, Internal Audit, Operations, IT, and other business functions in Canada and the U.S.
* Translate complex financial and accounting matters into clear, actionable insights for both financial and non\-financial stakeholders.
Champion a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.  
* 

  

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------

### **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
* 10\+ years of progressive accounting and/or finance experience, including significant experience in controllership, financial accounting, or financial reporting.
* 5\+ years of leadership experience with demonstrated success leading, coaching, and developing accounting or finance professionals.
* Strong knowledge of U.S. GAAP, financial reporting, accounting principles, and internal controls.

* Strong understanding of SOX compliance and internal control requirements within a large, complex organization.
* Experience partnering effectively with internal and external auditors.
* Strong executive communication, business partnership, and influencing skills.
* Demonstrated ability to lead through change, solve complex problems, and manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel and experience working with enterprise financial systems.
